$Comment: Martha's Family: reach Revered with Martha, the rank her favor calls Family, and collect her gift.
Earned once and kept, like Martha's Neighbor: no Parent, so no yearly copy, and no full_table tag.
REPUTATION_RANK credits every rank a player's favor has reached, each time their favor changes and
when they log in. Target is the rank id and Qualifier the reputation id. The criterion's TextKey
words the step with Martha's own rank name. The _Harvest_Feast folder makes the id
harvest_feast_marthas_family, and its words come from the keys that id spells.
The gift waits in Rewards.Claim on the achievements page until the player collects it: Harvest Coins,
pumpkin pies and meat pies, and MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Boost_Token, half again as much XP in every
skill for an hour, which the player starts when it suits them. The token row's own Requires, the
